book.name: FILIPOS
book.title: FILIPOS Filipos janinhahbo qui Pablonen raanni joi

content: Jahuen quiquin jati jenebehnani Cristo jahui

Criston jonibohax tah non yohinanti jai, shinan hinanhahnani. Joni huetsahon tah non hihti shinanti jai. Jahuen yoshin noquen jointi janin jai quen tah non nincacahananti jai. Yomanahtaibohon shinanti tah non jai. Jaa copi hen mato yohihi nincanahue.
Hen hihti jenimascanon huesti shinanya jihuenahue. Criston matohon shinanni quescajanahue, joni huestahon shinanhahnani. Huesti shinanyahpabo res janahue, huetsajaquin shinanyamaquin.
Jahuabi sinataxma teenahue. Hihcoinicamayamanahue. Noquen huetsa yohuanquihnnoxon mia mentan hashoan shinanya siri jaa hihqui shinanhue.
Mina res shinanyamahue. Mina res shinanxonma bi caibaana rihbi hahxonhue.
Noquen Hihbo Jesucristonen hahni quescajanahue.
Papa quescapahax bi ta jeenhihquish jonishqui, jahuen coshi jenebehnani.
Jahuen coshi xaba jenebehnani jonish cahen jonin yorayahpa sca janish. Yorayahpahax bi jonibo hahxonnica res quescascai. Joniscaax, caibo mentan hashoan jahuama quesca sca jai.
Jaabo jihuemanoxon mahuahue Papan jaah mahuati. Jihui qui hueonahbo bi nincanicaxon mahuanoxon caman tenequin.
Jaa copi ta Papan jaa yohinishqui: Mia tah min jatihibichin hihbo sca qui. Miin jane ta jatihibi jane mentan hashoan hani qui.
Jatihibi jonibaan sca raboxonen nihxon jahuen janen yocayaxihnon ta jascajanishqui, naihoh quehabaan, nai naman jihuetaibaan rihbi, mai chicho quehabaan rihbi. Jaabo yohihi ta jascanishqui.
Mia tah min noquen Hihbo Jesucristo qui hih ta jayaxihcanihqui, jatihibi. Jaatian ta Papa Dios hihti coshi shinanya hihqui honanyaxihcanihqui.
Xabayahpabo non jai

Jaa copi hea nincanahue, hea huetsabaan. Hea jano hihqui tian res ma bi hea jano hihyamahiya hashoan sca nincaquin sirijaxon, Criston shinanyahpaboxon mato janin jahuen shinan hichajanahue. Heen Hihbo queenai quescayama japaho hihquish jihuenahue.
Maton jointi janin teetai ta Papan coshi qui. Teeti shinan mato hinanxon ta hahan teeti coshi rihbi Papan mato hinanihqui, jan costanai quesca sca man teexonnon.
Man hahcai jatihibi tah man join hihquinanxonma man hahtihi, tsohquibi yohuanxonma hahquin.

Ponte shinanyahpabo sca jihuenahue, jahuabi tiroma shinanaxma. Papan siri baquebo tah man nincayosmabo tocan man jihuetihi, tiromabo tocan hihquish bi ponte res jihueti. Mai mehabo tocan tah man huishi xabatai quesca man jatihi, Papan xabayahpabo sca jai.
Johuepan xabajaquin hahcajaquin Papan joi honanmanahue. Jaatian ta Cristo jahuiya hen jenimayaxihqui, yanca res hen teeyamani hihquish copi. Mato copi tah hen Cristo bebon mequen nihyamayaxihqui.
Hean joi yohihah man noquen Hihbo nincacoinscai copi hea nenoxon rehtenoxihquibaan bi tah hen jenimaresai. Mato betanbi tah hen jenimahi.
Jascarihbihi jenimanahue, hea hihqui quescari jenimanahue.
Timoteo betan Epafrodito
Histon tahni tah hen mato qui Timoteo raanti shinanai, jenquetsi man jihuetain honannoxon. Noquen Hihbo queenaiya tah hen basima tahni raantihi, joiya joribiscaiya sca hen jointi siricahinnon.
Timoteo quescapah tah hen neno huetsa yamahi, matohon shinancoinxon mato sirijaquin coirannicah.
Texen ta jatona res coiraniqui, Cristona jisxonyamaquin.
Timoteo tah man honanscai. Jahuen papa betanbi teeti quesca ta hehbetan Papan joi yohihi tee teenishqui, maton jisnonbi. Jenquetsahpa shinanya hin hihxon tah man honanscai.
Jaa copi tah hen jaa raanti shinanai. Jenquetsaja cahra hea janoxihcanihquin, rehtequin, rehteyamaquin, honanxon sca tah hen jaa raanscatihi.
Jaabi ta heabi mato janin histon tahni catihi, Criston hea picohah. Jan hea jascajaxontihi tah hen shinanai.
Epafrodito pari raanti ta jaiqui hihxon tah hen jaa pari raantihi. Jaa ta heen huetsa qui, hea yanapannicah. Hehbe sontaro can. Man raanah ta joxon hea hihti yanapancachihiqui, sirijaquin hahxonquin.
Jaa hihti hisinai joi man nincaho honanxon ta masa tenehax mato jisi hihti cacatsihscaiqui. Jaa copi tah hen raanti shinanai.
Mahua hisin ta jahoxqui. Mahuatihi bi ta rohatipishqui, Papan rohajahah. Jahan shinanxon, hehon rihbi shinanxon ta Papan jaa rohajahipishqui, tiroma honanya hihquish hashoan bena sca hen jayamanon.
Jaa copi tah hen rahmabi jaa raanti shinanai, jaa jisish man jenimascanon. Jano caxon mato yohihah tah man jenimatihi, nenohax ta hea rihbi jointi siricahintihi.
Jaa copi jenimaxon bihnahue mato qui nocotaiton. Hahxon tah min noque jai, Papan, jaax jenimanahue. Papan joi yohinica jatihibi Johue hahxon, jaabo pishinaibo jato hinannahue, yanapanquin.
Cristo teexonquin ta mahuatihi bi rohatipishqui. Hea yanapanquin tah man jaa neno raanhohqui. Joxon ta Hahrai mahuapaho hihxonma bi tenexon Cristo hahxonnoxon hea yanapancachihiqui.
